name: reporter_cluster_bubble_handbook
description: Bubble family handbook: bubble (L1-L7), cs_bubble (L1-L6), labeled_bubble (L1-L5), cs_labeled_bubble (L1-L5). 23 layouts.
source:
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
volume = src.v
daily_ret = (close - (close >> 1)) / (close >> 1)
vol_20 = stddev(period=20)(daily_ret)
rsi_14 = rsi(period=14)(close)
ts = index()

# === BUBBLE L1-L7 ===
bubble(title='L1: Vol vs Return vs Volume', category='01 bubble L1: Basic'
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)

bubble(title='L2: Risk-Return (Blue)', category='02 bubble L2: Color',
  series_name='Risk-Return', color=Color.Blue
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)

bubble(title='L3: Percent Axes', category='03 bubble L3: Percent',
  x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat, x_axis_dp=1,
  y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat, y_axis_dp=2,
  x_axis_label='Volatility', y_axis_label='Return'
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)

bubble(title='L4: Price vs RSI', category='04 bubble L4: Monetary',
  y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.MonetaryFormat, y_axis_dp=0,
  x_axis_label='RSI', y_axis_label='Close'
)(x=rsi_14, y=close, z=volume)

bubble(title='L5: Width Sizing', category='05 bubble L5: Sizing',
  min_size=4, max_size=40, size_by='width'
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)

bubble(title='L6: With Thresholds', category='06 bubble L6: Ref Lines',
  y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
  x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
  reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
    ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)])
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)

bubble(title='L7: Full Config', category='07 bubble L7: Full',
  series_name='Full', color=Color.Indigo, min_size=6, max_size=30,
  size_by='area', x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat, x_axis_dp=1,
  y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat, y_axis_dp=2,
  x_axis_label='Volatility', y_axis_label='Return',
  reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
    ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)]),
  order=1
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)

# === CS_BUBBLE L1-L6 ===
cs_bubble(title='L1: Return Magnitude', category='08 cs_bubble L1: Basic'
)(y=daily_ret)

cs_bubble(title='L2: Custom Colors', category='09 cs_bubble L2: Colors',
  colors=[Color.Blue, Color.Red, Color.Green]
)(y=daily_ret)

cs_bubble(title='L3: Percent Format', category='10 cs_bubble L3: Percent',
  y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat, y_axis_dp=2
)(y=daily_ret)

cs_bubble(title='L4: Top 2 Assets', category='11 cs_bubble L4: Max Assets',
  max_assets=2
)(y=daily_ret)

cs_bubble(title='L5: Width Sizing', category='12 cs_bubble L5: Sizing',
  min_size=4, max_size=40, size_by='width'
)(y=daily_ret)

cs_bubble(title='L6: With Zero Line', category='13 cs_bubble L6: Ref Lines',
  y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
  reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
    ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)])
)(y=daily_ret)

# === LABELED BUBBLE L1-L5 ===
# Prepare values for labeled bubble (per-asset, explicit x,y,z triples)
ret_20 = sma(period=20)(daily_ret)
ret_50 = sma(period=50)(daily_ret)
vol_50 = stddev(period=50)(daily_ret)
avg_vol_20 = sma(period=20)(volume)
avg_vol_50 = sma(period=50)(volume)

# L1: Basic labeled bubble — Two named points
labeled_bubble(
    title='L1: 20d vs 50d Lookback',
    category='14 labeled_bubble L1: Basic',
    points=LabeledPointSchema(points=[
        LabeledPointSpec(label='20-Day', color=Color.Blue),
        LabeledPointSpec(label='50-Day', color=Color.Gray)
    ]),
    x_axis_label='Volatility',
    y_axis_label='Avg Return',
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat
)(xyz_triples=(vol_20, ret_20, avg_vol_20, vol_50, ret_50, avg_vol_50))

# L2: Colors and markers
labeled_bubble(
    title='L2: Colored Points with Markers',
    category='15 labeled_bubble L2: Colors',
    points=LabeledPointSchema(points=[
        LabeledPointSpec(label='20-Day', color=Color.Blue, marker=MarkerSymbol.DiamondMarker),
        LabeledPointSpec(label='50-Day', color=Color.Orange, marker=MarkerSymbol.TriangleMarker)
    ]),
    x_axis_label='Volatility',
    y_axis_label='Avg Return',
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat
)(xyz_triples=(vol_20, ret_20, avg_vol_20, vol_50, ret_50, avg_vol_50))

# L3: Reference lines (x and y separate)
labeled_bubble(
    title='L3: With Reference Lines',
    category='16 labeled_bubble L3: Ref Lines',
    points=LabeledPointSchema(points=[
        LabeledPointSpec(label='20-Day', color=Color.Blue),
        LabeledPointSpec(label='50-Day', color=Color.Gray)
    ]),
    x_reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.01, title='1% Vol', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    y_reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat
)(xyz_triples=(vol_20, ret_20, avg_vol_20, vol_50, ret_50, avg_vol_50))

# L4: Bubble sizing options
labeled_bubble(
    title='L4: Custom Sizing',
    category='17 labeled_bubble L4: Sizing',
    points=LabeledPointSchema(points=[
        LabeledPointSpec(label='20-Day', color=Color.Blue),
        LabeledPointSpec(label='50-Day', color=Color.Gray)
    ]),
    min_size='5',
    max_size='25%',
    size_by='width',
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat
)(xyz_triples=(vol_20, ret_20, avg_vol_20, vol_50, ret_50, avg_vol_50))

# L5: Full config
labeled_bubble(
    title='L5: Full Config',
    category='18 labeled_bubble L5: Full',
    points=LabeledPointSchema(points=[
        LabeledPointSpec(label='20-Day', color=Color.Blue, marker=MarkerSymbol.CircleMarker),
        LabeledPointSpec(label='50-Day', color=Color.Indigo, marker=MarkerSymbol.SquareMarker)
    ]),
    x_axis_label='Volatility',
    y_axis_label='Avg Return',
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat, x_axis_dp=1,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat, y_axis_dp=2,
    min_size='4',
    max_size='20%',
    x_reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.01, title='1% Vol', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    y_reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=1
)(xyz_triples=(vol_20, ret_20, avg_vol_20, vol_50, ret_50, avg_vol_50))

# === CS_LABELED_BUBBLE L1-L5 ===

# L1: Basic auto-labeled bubble
cs_labeled_bubble(
    title='L1: Risk vs Return vs Volume',
    category='19 cs_labeled_bubble L1: Basic',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    x_axis_label='Avg Volatility',
    y_axis_label='Avg Return',
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)

# L2: No data labels
cs_labeled_bubble(
    title='L2: No Labels',
    category='20 cs_labeled_bubble L2: No Labels',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=False,
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)

# L3: Colors + max_assets
cs_labeled_bubble(
    title='L3: Colors + Top 2',
    category='21 cs_labeled_bubble L3: Colors',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    colors=[Color.Blue, Color.Green, Color.Orange],
    max_assets=2,
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_label='Volatility',
    y_axis_label='Return'
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)

# L4: Reference lines + sizing
cs_labeled_bubble(
    title='L4: Ref Lines + Sizing',
    category='22 cs_labeled_bubble L4: Ref Lines',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    min_size='5',
    max_size='25%',
    size_by='width',
    x_reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.01, title='1% Vol', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    y_reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_label='Volatility',
    y_axis_label='Return'
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)

# L5: Full config
cs_labeled_bubble(
    title='L5: Full Config',
    category='23 cs_labeled_bubble L5: Full',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    colors=[Color.Blue, Color.Red, Color.Green],
    min_size='4',
    max_size='20%',
    size_by='area',
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat, x_axis_dp=1,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat, y_axis_dp=2,
    x_axis_label='Volatility',
    y_axis_label='Return',
    x_reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.01, title='1% Vol', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    y_reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=1
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)

# ========================================================================
# CS_LABELED_BUBBLE — AGG DIVERSITY (17 values)
# ========================================================================

cs_labeled_bubble(
    agg=AggregationType.Sum,
    category='AD cs_labeled_bubble agg=Sum'
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)

cs_labeled_bubble(
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    category='AD cs_labeled_bubble agg=Last'
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)

cs_labeled_bubble(
    agg=AggregationType.Min,
    category='AD cs_labeled_bubble agg=Min'
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)

cs_labeled_bubble(
    agg=AggregationType.Max,
    category='AD cs_labeled_bubble agg=Max'
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)

cs_labeled_bubble(
    agg=AggregationType.Median,
    category='AD cs_labeled_bubble agg=Median'
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)

cs_labeled_bubble(
    agg=AggregationType.Std,
    category='AD cs_labeled_bubble agg=Std'
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)

cs_labeled_bubble(
    agg=AggregationType.Count,
    category='AD cs_labeled_bubble agg=Count'
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)

cs_labeled_bubble(
    agg=AggregationType.First,
    category='AD cs_labeled_bubble agg=First'
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)

cs_labeled_bubble(
    agg=AggregationType.All,
    category='AD cs_labeled_bubble agg=All'
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)

cs_labeled_bubble(
    agg=AggregationType.Any,
    category='AD cs_labeled_bubble agg=Any'
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)

cs_labeled_bubble(
    agg=AggregationType.CountDistinct,
    category='AD cs_labeled_bubble agg=CountDistinct'
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)

cs_labeled_bubble(
    agg=AggregationType.Kurtosis,
    category='AD cs_labeled_bubble agg=Kurtosis'
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)

cs_labeled_bubble(
    agg=AggregationType.Mode,
    category='AD cs_labeled_bubble agg=Mode'
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)

cs_labeled_bubble(
    agg=AggregationType.Product,
    category='AD cs_labeled_bubble agg=Product'
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)

cs_labeled_bubble(
    agg=AggregationType.Quantile,
    category='AD cs_labeled_bubble agg=Quantile'
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)

cs_labeled_bubble(
    agg=AggregationType.Skew,
    category='AD cs_labeled_bubble agg=Skew'
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)

cs_labeled_bubble(
    agg=AggregationType.Var,
    category='AD cs_labeled_bubble agg=Var'
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)
